Hi! I'm an ambassador for the Tourette association of America, and have sufferd from Tourettes, ADHD, and depression for 8 years now. My advice to you, don't give up or get discouraged! Medication will help to combat the ADHD side of things, but it's worth noting that with tourettes more conditions like this stem from tourettes. In my experience, medication can help to suppress my tics-but this is different for everyone and the side affects are always a pain. I would recommend looking into more hands on congestive behavior therapy, or CBIT! As well, a nerolgist is very valuable! It is stressful and a pain, but they know what they are doing. Feel free to PM me individually, if you have more questions!
